newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Garanti investment trust to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Garanti investment trust to float shares.

text.p: Turkish investment trust Garanti Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. said it would offer 80 percent of its 250 billion lira capital to public on November 7-8.
The price per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share will be fixed at 1,050 lira according to the press release.
The investment trust is owned by Garanti Yatirim ve Ticaret Bankasi, the investment arm of Turkiye Garanti Bankasi which belongs to financial and commercial Dogus group.
The offer will be carried out by a consortium consisting of Garanti Yatirim Bankasi, T.Garanti Bankasi and Garanti Menkul Kiymetler A.S.
The publicly sold shares will afterwards be listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
